purpose: Initial source inventory for the Argus soap-and-water handwashing rebuild; not a ready-to-train dataset.
screening_rules: Inspect raw visual actions before approving a source; titles and descriptions do not establish technique coverage.
Record cut boundaries, unknown intervals, and altered playback speed; edited clips cannot establish full-procedure timing.
Group translations, reposts, and alternate edits of the same performance before train/validation/test splitting.
CDC community guidance is not automatically a complete WHO technique demonstration.
Exclude animation, talking-head-only advice, and alcohol-only or surgical-preparation footage from the initial routine soap-and-water technique dataset.
Review source reuse conditions and acquisition route before importing media.
